name: Delta
tagline: A C64-style shmup. Best score lives in the file.
description:
Works offline. No account, no install. Your best score is saved inside this GIF — close it, copy it, come back, the number is still there.

You are a little ship on the left. Waves of aliens come from the right in C64 Delta formations: lines, loops, rocks that scrape the hull. Three lives. Shoot, dodge, last.

On a phone the D-pad and FIRE sit under your thumbs (slide the pad for diagonals). On a computer it is the arrows or WASD, and space to fire. Tap or press space on the title to start. Back on a phone returns to the title.

An unofficial port of HTML5 Delta by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. The original title tune was a SID recording and is not in this copy — the formations are. Shoot and explode are synthesized here.
